name: WeniEval-Benchmark-1.0.0
description: WeniEval is a benchmark for evaluating language understanding and conversational capabilities on the Weni dataset family, focused on dialog-centric classification and question answering tasks. It measures model performance on a variety of text-based conversational tasks (intent/classification, QA and dialogue understanding) across realistic chat examples. The benchmark is intended to assess both standard accuracy and robustness on conversation-driven NLP tasks.
reputation: Known within the Portuguese/dialogue-NLP community as a useful conversational evaluation suite but not as widely adopted internationally as major multilingual benchmarks.
